# CCDD — Context Contract-Driven Development

> Methodology for reliable AI agents: the LLM's context (prompts, policies)
> becomes a versioned, signed, gate-enforced CONTRACT (context.yaml). L1 lint,
> L2 deterministic regression gate (R1-R9), L3 runtime assembly + guardrails.
> This page publishes the methodology's own docs as searchable skills.

## Docs

- [Landing](/index.html)
- [Repository](https://github.com/MauricioPerera/ccdd)
